# 2 Chronicles Chapter 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was when-was-established kingdom-of Rehoboam and-when-he-was-strong he-forsook law-of YHWH and-all Israel with-him.

**2** And-it-was in-year the-fifth of-the-king Rehoboam he-came-up Shishak king-of Egypt against Jerusalem for they-were-unfaithful against-YHWH

**3** with-twelve-hundred chariots and-sixty-thousand horsemen and-without number the-people who came with-him from-Egypt Lubim Sukkiim and-Cushites.

**4** And-he-captured the-cities the-fortified that were-for-Judah and-he-came to Jerusalem.

**5** And-Shemaiah the-prophet came to Rehoboam and-leaders-of Judah who gathered to-Jerusalem from-before Shishak and-he-said to-them thus says YHWH you you-forsook-Me and-also I I-forsook you in-hand-of Shishak.

**6** And-they-humbled-themselves leaders-of Israel and-the-king and-they-said righteous is YHWH.

**7** And-when-saw YHWH that they-humbled-themselves was word-of YHWH to-Shemaiah saying they-humbled-themselves not I-will-destroy-them and-I-will-give to-them shortly for-deliverance and-not shall-pour-out My-wrath on Jerusalem by-hand-of Shishak.

**8** For they-shall-be to-him for-servants and-they-shall-know My-service and-service-of kingdoms-of the-lands.

**9** And-he-came-up Shishak king-of Egypt against Jerusalem and-he-took the-treasures-of house-of YHWH and-the-treasures-of house-of the-king all he-took and-he-took the-shields-of the-gold that made Solomon.

**10** And-he-made the-king Rehoboam in-their-place shields-of bronze and-he-entrusted on-hand-of chiefs-of the-runners the-keepers-of entrance-of house-of the-king.

**11** And-it-was as-often-as came the-king to-house-of YHWH came the-runners and-they-bore-them and-they-returned-them to room-of the-runners.

**12** And-when-he-humbled-himself turned from-him anger-of YHWH and-not to-destroy completely and-also in-Judah were things good.

**13** And-he-strengthened-himself the-king Rehoboam in-Jerusalem and-he-reigned for son-of forty-and-one years was-Rehoboam in-his-reigning and-seventeen years he-reigned in-Jerusalem the-city that chose YHWH to-put His-name there from-all tribes-of Israel and-name-of his-mother was-Naamah the-Ammonite.

**14** And-he-did the-evil for not he-fixed his-heart to-seek YHWH.

**15** And-acts-of Rehoboam the-first and-the-last are-they-not written in-words-of Shemaiah the-prophet and-Iddo the-seer for-registering and-wars-of Rehoboam and-Jeroboam all the-days.

**16** And-he-lay-down Rehoboam with his-fathers and-he-was-buried in-city-of David and-he-reigned Abijah his-son in-his-place.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **12:1**: when-he-was-strong he-forsook — The Chronicler's recurring pattern: strength leads to pride, pride leads to abandonment of God. This pattern will repeat through king after king.

- **12:5-6**: you-forsook-Me...righteous is YHWH — The prophetic confrontation produces genuine repentance. The confession 'righteous is YHWH' acknowledges that judgment is deserved.

- **12:8**: My-service and-service-of kingdoms — A pedagogical judgment: subjection to Egypt will teach Israel the difference between serving YHWH and serving pagan overlords.


— EMET
